# Speckyboy

> Speckyboy is a design resource hub specializing in curated typography and font collections for creative professionals.

Speckyboy provides designers with expertly selected font libraries, typeface guides, and typography resources. The site focuses on helping designers choose appropriate fonts for logos, branding, and other design projects across multiple typeface categories.

## Key Topics

- Logo Fonts
- Typography Guide
- Font Selection
- Sans-Serif Fonts
- Serif Fonts
- Script Fonts
- Logo Design
- Brand Identity
- Helvetica
- Proxima Nova
- Roboto
- Inter
- Futura
- Design Resources

## Typography & Font Guides

- [40+ Best Logo Fonts for Designers in 2026](https://speckyboy.com/logo-typeface-font): Curated collection of 40+ logo fonts including serif, sans-serif, script, and decorative typefaces for designers.
